root_cause.text: The error reporting call to `fserror_report_io()` in `iomap_finish_folio_read()` was placed after decrementing `ifs->read_bytes_pending`, which allows a race where another in-flight read completion can unlock the folio and trigger truncation that clears `folio->mapping`, leading to a NULL dereference when `folio->mapping->host` is later accessed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly describes the race: "Once iomap_finish_folio_read() decrements read_bytes_pending, another in-flight read can complete and end the read on the folio, which unlocks it. This allows truncate logic to run and detach the folio (set folio->mapping to NULL). The error reporting path then can dereference a NULL folio->mapping." The patch moves the `fserror_report_io()` call to before the `ifs->read_bytes_pending` decrement to fix the issue.
